meta.title: Nidra — AI software development for small businesses
meta.description: We automate processes and build AI software for small and medium businesses. A two-week assessment, without pilots that never reach production.

hero.title: AI is useful once it reaches production.
hero.titleAccent: Everything else is an expensive pilot.
hero.lead: We work with small and medium businesses that have costly manual processes and want them solved, not experimented on. We start by measuring where it's worth it and where it isn't.

credibility.experienceDetail: Microservices, APIs and production applications for global clients.
credibility.focusDetail: AI applied to concrete processes, with automated quality evaluation.
credibility.locationDetail: Remote work with Spanish- and English-speaking companies.

services.title: Six services, not a catalogue
services.lead: We'd rather do a few things well. If what you need isn't here, we'll say so.

process.title: Measure first, build second
process.lead: The order matters. Most AI projects fail because building starts before anyone knows which problem it solves.

steps.title: Assessment
steps.body: Two or three weeks surveying real processes, with measured volumes and times. The output is a list ranked by cost and benefit, including what is better left alone.

steps.title: Definition
steps.body: We write down what will be built and how it will be verified before writing code. Technical decisions are documented and they're yours.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: Working increments, with automated tests from day one. You see progress every week, not a demo at the end.

steps.title: Production
steps.body: Deployment with quality measurement, alerts and documentation. The code and the infrastructure end up in your name.

technologies.note: We build on these platforms. We are not commercial partners and we are not certified by them: this is the infrastructure we use to build.

closing.title: Got a process that eats hours every week?
closing.lead: Tell us which one. If we don't think AI is the answer, we'll say so.

meta.title: Privacy policy — Nidra
meta.description: What personal data we collect, why, how long we keep it and how to exercise your rights.

sections.title: What we collect
body: We collect only what you give us in the contact form: name, email, company (optional), the service you're asking about and the text of your message.
This site uses no cookies and no persistent tracking identifiers. That's why you won't find a consent banner: there is nothing to consent to.
We measure visits in aggregate and anonymously, without personal data and without any ability to work out who you are or follow you across sites.

sections.title: What we use it for
body: Only to answer your enquiry. We don't use your data for advertising, we don't combine it with other sources, and we don't sell or hand it to third parties for commercial purposes.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: The site stores no enquiries in any database. The message is delivered to our mailbox, and its retention is governed by our mail management, where it is kept for the duration of the commercial conversation and for at most two years.
If you ask us to delete it sooner, we do.

sections.title: Third-party services
body: We use a transactional email provider to deliver messages, which processes the message in order to get it to our mailbox.
If you book a meeting, scheduling happens on an external calendar platform. Any data you enter there is governed by that provider's privacy policy, not by this one.
If we add a conversational assistant in the future, we will update this policy before putting it into operation, stating what data it collects and why.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can ask us for access to the data we hold about you, its correction or its deletion. Write to hola@nidra.cloud and we'll respond within the timeframes set by applicable law.
In Argentina, the supervisory authority for personal data is the Agencia de Acceso a la Información Pública.

sections.title: Controller
body: Nidra, Buenos Aires, Argentina. Contact: hola@nidra.cloud

meta.title: Terms of use — Nidra
meta.description: Terms of use for the Nidra website.

sections.title: Scope of this site
body: This site describes Nidra's services for information purposes. Its content is not a contractual offer or a quote: the scope, timeline and price of any work are agreed in writing case by case.

sections.title: Timelines and estimates
body: The timelines published in the services section are estimates based on work of comparable scope. A project's actual timeline depends on its scope, on the availability of information and on client dependencies, and is confirmed when the work is agreed.

sections.title: Third-party trademarks
body: The names of platforms, products and companies mentioned on this site belong to their respective owners and are used nominatively, solely to describe which technologies we work with or which systems we can integrate.
Their mention implies no commercial partnership, certification, sponsorship or endorsement of Nidra by those organisations.

sections.title: Ownership of content
body: The text and design of this site are the property of Nidra. You may quote them with attribution and a link to the source.

sections.title: Changes
